title: Texas authorized what was already driving

lines: Every mile is logged. Who counts the crashes?
By October 28th, 2025 Aurora reported passing 100,000 driverless miles on public roads.

481 days. Five of seven marks in the final 89.
The seventh mount is the hearing on August 25th, 2026, and it carries nothing yet.
35 trucks. No one in the cab.
Kodiak hauls triple trailers for Atlas Energy Solutions inside a fleet of 35 driverless trucks with no human in the cab. That was the count on June 30th, 2026.
Kodiak's securities filing counts these in the triples configuration, along Atlas's 42 mile Dune Express conveyor. The drawing shows 1,400. The record says more.
